listings.desc: Tucked away in Gold Hill on five golden acres, this single story ranch style home offers the kind of setting that makes you want to slow down and stay a while. Surrounded by rolling, oak studded terrain with beautiful valley and mountain views, the property combines privacy, space and effortless indoor/outdoor living. At the heart of the home, a vaulted great room is filled with natural light from a dramatic wall of arched windows that frame the landscape beyond. A gas stove adds warmth and character, while French doors open to the view over the deck. The kitchen features granite countertops, light wood cabinetry, a tumbled stone backsplash and gas cooktop, with an adjoining dining area. The spacious primary suite offers its own peaceful retreat, including a freestanding soaking tub beneath a sunlit corner window, separate walk-in shower and dual sink vanity. Three additional bedrooms include a Jack n Jill set up and one near the garage entry providing plenty of flexibility for family and/or guests. There is a dedicated office/den as well. Go outside and see how the property truly shines. A fenced in-ground pool and generous patio create a fabulous setting for summer afternoons and gatherings, all against a backdrop of sweeping valley, mountain views and sunsets. Natural landscaping, a welcoming covered front porch and five acres provide room to enjoy the outdoors without sacrificing privacy. There is plenty of room here to park all the things necessary to enjoy foothill life; boat, RV or trailers. The land is usable with lots of space to plant a garden and for the chicken

listings.agent: Kristina Agustin — Vista Sotheby's International Realty
listings.desc: Welcome to this charming mini ranch with an ADU, tucked behind a gated entrance at the end of a paved driveway, offering privacy, versatility, and lovely views in a peaceful country setting. The single-story ranch home design welcomes you into a light-filled living room where vaulted ceilings and expansive picture windows showcase the scenery beyond. The updated kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a huge island/dining bar, creating an inviting space for everyday country living. The primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, privacy and a fireplace. The additional room off of the primary is perfect for a home office, craft room, or workout space a flexible area that can easily adapt to your needs. This space as well as the living room both offer direct access to the expansive deck, where a pergola featuring ceiling fans and lighting that sets the stage for year-round enjoyment, complete with a full outdoor kitchen. Outside, the amenities continue with a sparkling in-ground pool, beautifully landscaped grounds, owned solar and thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces. Horse enthusiasts will appreciate the round pen and large arena, three covered turnouts, and cross-fenced pastures, along with three storage sheds for a tack room, equipment, and hay storage. Steel rail fencing lines the front of the property, and a wine cave adds another unique touch. A detached one-bedroom, one-bath ADU with washer/dryer included offers excellent potential for guests, a caretaker, or rental income. Offering the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and ranch living

listings.desc: Major price reduction! Sought-after area. Minutes from shopping, schools. Country living at its finest. Don't miss the approx. 750SF ultimate entertainment hub: game room plus extra room & bath situated above the detached three-car garage. Connected to the main house by a breeze-catching walkway, this private extra space makes a perfect teen hangout or man cave. The custom-built, two-story family residence features four bedrooms (one remote downstairs), three bathrooms, a formal dining room, separate living and family spaces, and a chef's dream kitchen. Outside, a stunning built-in pool is bordered by vibrant flowers and lush greenery. Set on nearly six acres, the estate includes fenced areas, a loafing shed, and views of Sacramento including spectacular front-row seats to Fourth of July fireworks.

The outdoor setting is where this property truly shines. A stunning infinity-edge saltwater pool and spa overlook the surrounding hills, creating a spectacular backdrop for relaxing and entertaining. Expansive travertine surrounds the pool, complemented by a dedicated outdoor shower and bathroom for added convenience. At the heart of the home is a spacious chef's kitchen featuring granite countertops and generous prep and gathering space. Engineered wood flooring, a gas fireplace, Andersen dual-pane windows and a whole-house fan add warmth, comfort and efficiency throughout. The flexible floor plan includes a separate living area with its own bedroom, full bathroom, private entrance and gated outdoor spaceideal for guest accommodations, a private office, studio or additional living space. Beyond the main residence, an approximately 20' x 30' detached workshop with a roll-up door and dedicated driveway offers exceptional space for projects, hobbies, equipment or storage. The 4-car garage provides even more room for vehicles and recreational gear. Additional property features include owned solar, a generator, reverse-osmosis system, well, septic, greenhouse and extensive drip irrigation. Private and peaceful yet conveniently located near Highway 50, Placerville and El Dor

Blending timeless foothills charm with refined living, this impressive home opens to light-filled interior spaces defined by soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and a seamless layout designed for both everyday comfort and grand entertaining. The heart of the home features a chef's kitchen complete with Highlighted by incredible natural light and framed outdoor views, every bedroom in the residence opens to its own private balcony.
